race.comment: MELISSA KATE (8) has a moderate winning strike rate but performed well last time at Mt Gambier, finishing third after being in the firing line on the bend. Ticking along nicely at the ripe old age of 10 and Walters knows her like the back of her hand. Will land handy and be in this for a long way. SHOOTING FOR STARS (7) was responsible for a solid effort last time out when third at Warracknabeal over 1000m, beaten less than a length after scoring well at Mt Gambier the start prior. Can keep the ball rolling. JUST LIKE LISA (6) hasn't been far away lately, last time out finishing a narrow fourth at Warracknabeal. Doesn't need to improve much to land a winning punch. FOREVER WAITING (2) returns and does boast a fresh win. Watch for him warming late.
